channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: European Council President calls on Iran to resume cooperation with IAEA
item.description:
European Council President António Costa spoke with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and called on Tehran to resume cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).
Costa also called on Iran to halt attacks against neighboring countries and fully restore freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Milei calls UN 'useless' during General Assembly address
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei blasts the UN as “useless," accusing it of hypocrisy, bureaucratic overreach and bias against Israel in a fiery speech.

item.title: Report: Crew members of USS Abraham Lincoln faced self-harm incidents
item.description:
Sailors serving aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln faced several self-harm incidents during the months of fighting against Iran, according to a letter from the acting Secretary of the Navy obtained by CNN. He said that none of the crew members died during operations against Iran.
According to CNN, the number of reported cases among the crew was consistent with figures recorded across the US Navy in 2024, when 356 such cases were reported among approximately 337,000 active-duty personnel.

item.title: Chinese President arrives in US ahead of Trump summit
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping landed at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland on Wednesday, ahead of his summit with US President Donald Trump.
Trump personally arrived at the tarmac to welcome the Chinese president.

item.title: Poll: Bennett continues to lose ground
item.description: A Channel 13 News poll shows Naftali Bennett’s Together party falling to a new low of 11 seats, while the Religious Zionist-Zehut alliance remains steady at six.

item.title: 13-year-old critically injured after being hit by car in Kiryat Bialik
item.description:
A 13-year-old boy was critically injured after being struck by a car in Kiryat Bialik.
Magen David Adom paramedics provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Rambam Hospital in Haifa.

item.title: After Maccabim checkpoint attack | Regional leaders: The security reality must change
item.description: The heads of the Binyamin and Samaria regional councils visit Shaare Zedek Hospital together to stand with the family of Neria Leiter, who was seriously injured: “The government must turn everything upside down."

item.title: Military exercise to take place Thursday morning in Zikim Beach area
item.description:
A military exercise will take place Thursday morning in the Zikim Beach area, within the Hof Ashkelon Regional Council.
As part of the exercise, increased activity by security forces, vehicles, and vessels is expected, along with sounds of gunfire and explosions in the area.

item.title: Shaare Zedek Hospital: Neria Leiter remains in serious condition, his life is in danger
item.description:
Shaare Zedek Hospital issued an update on Neria Leiter’s condition, saying, "After undergoing life-saving procedures in the trauma unit, Neria underwent complex brain surgery that lasted several hours, along with additional treatments."
"His condition remains very serious, and his life is in danger. Medical teams, including surgical and intensive care teams, continue to provide Neria with life-saving treatment, while social workers remain closely and sensitively involved in supporting his family throughout."

item.title: Embassy spokeswoman: Amb. Leiter received the news on the way to an interview
item.description: Israeli Embassy spokesperson Tal Naim was with Ambassador Yechiel Leiter in New York when he learned that his son Neria had been critically wounded in a terrorist attack.

item.title: Herzog to world leaders: ‘Do not erase October 7th from the story’
item.description: President Isaac Herzog warns world leaders criticizing Israel not to erase October 7th or demand standards of Israel they would not apply to themselves.

item.title: Before leaving for US: Prime Minister Netanyahu visits Leiter family at hospital
item.description:
Before departing for the UN General Assembly, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited Shaare Zedek Medical Center, where he met with the family of Neria Leiter, who was critically wounded in Wednesday’s terrorist attack.
Netanyahu asked the public to pray for the recovery of Neria Dov ben Chana.

item.title: Yisrael Ganz: "Stop encouraging terror in the name of peace"
item.description: Yesha Council Chairman Yisrael Ganz speaks from Shaare Zedek Hospital after Ambassador Yechiel Leiter's son Neria was critically wounded in a terrorist attack in Binyamin.

item.title: Security warnings cut Netanyahu’s US visit to just seven hours
item.description: Netanyahu is reportedly set to spend just seven hours in the US after security officials urged him to minimize his stay amid concrete warnings over the trip.

item.title: Watch: Police uncover 25-meter-deep tunnel and weapons in Qalqilya
item.description: Israeli forces uncover a tunnel at least 25 meters deep and a second excavation in Qalqilya, seizing an M16, sniper rifle, ammunition and fertilizer.

item.title: $2.45 billion in six months: Board of Peace unveils Gaza recovery plan
item.description: Board of Peace unveils a six-month Gaza recovery program featuring 66 projects costing about $2.45 billion, spanning infrastructure, security and jobs.

item.title: NYT shareholders sue for internal records on Israel-Hamas war coverage
item.description: Shareholders ask court to compel The New York Times Company to turn over internal documents concerning editorial standards and coverage of the Israel-Hamas war. Lawsuit also cites former Jewish employee's allegations of antisemitism and anti-Israel bias.

item.title: President Herzog shares prayer for Neria Leiter
item.description:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog issued a statement on Wednesday night offering a prayer for the complete and speedy recovery of Neria Leiter, a reservist soldier who was run over today in a terror attack at the Maccabim checkpoint.
Herzog noted that Leiter is the brother of Major Moshe Leiter, of blessed memory, a hero of Israel who fell at the beginning of the Swords of Iron War in Gaza.
“We send our wishes for a complete recovery to Neria, and strength to his wife and to his parents, Hannah and Yechiel Leiter, Israel's Ambassador to the United States. Neria is fighting for his life at this very hour, and we will pray for his recovery. We all stand with this dear family and send them our strength," Herzog stated.

item.title: Amb. Huckabee: Pray for Yechiel Leiter & entire family
item.description:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee published a message of support for his Israeli counterpart, Ambassador Yechiel Leiter, after the latter's son was severely injured in a ramming attack in the Binyamin Region.
"Pray for Yechiel Leiter & entire family. They lost a son in Gaza, killed by Hamas. Now a Palestinian terrorist attempts to murder IDF soldiers at a checkpoint. Standing with Yechiel Leiter," Huckabee wrote on X.

item.title: Israeli Ambassador calls for prayers for son injured in terror attack
item.description: Neria Leiter, son of Israeli Ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter, was critically wounded in the ramming attack on Route 443. Ambassador: "Neria needs a miracle."

item.title: Amb. Leiter: I believe that when the people of Israel unite, miracles happen
item.description:
Ambassador Yechiel Leiter commented on the injury of his son Neria in a terrorist ramming attack.
"I am grateful to the IDF, to the medical team at Shaare Zedek who are now fighting to save the life of Neria Dov ben Chana, and for the prayers of the people of Israel. I believe in the power of prayer, and I believe that when the people of Israel unite, miracles happen. Neria needs a miracle."
He added: "Neria continued to serve in the reserves after losing his older brother, Moshe Yedidya Leiter, of blessed memory. Since October 7th, he has served hundreds of days in the reserves on multiple fronts."
"Palestinian terrorism seeks to uproot the people of Israel from their land. They choose death - we choose life."

item.title: Neriya Leiter, son of Israeli Ambassador to the US, wounded in ramming attack
item.description:
The Binyamin Regional Council announced that reserve soldier Neriya Leiter, the son of Israeli Ambassador to the United States Yechiel Leiter and his wife, Chana, was wounded in Wednesday’s terrorist attack near Route 443.
The family asked the public to pray for the recovery of Neriya Dov ben Chana.
